definitions.gloss: safe deposit box; safety deposit box
definitions.explanation: A secure storage box provided by a bank for customers to store valuables, important documents, and other items.

examples.japanese: {貸金庫|かしきんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: To rent a safe deposit box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{貸金庫|かしきんこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}している→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧。
examples.english: I keep important documents in a safe deposit box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{貸金庫|かしきんこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧⟦{使用料|しようりょう}→使用料：29636_shiyouryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{安全性|あんぜんせい}→安全性：19384_anzensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Bank safe deposit boxes have an annual fee, but the security is high.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{貸|か}し→貸し：02578_kashi⟧ (rental; lending) + ⟦{金庫|きんこ}→金庫：01749_kinko⟧ (safe; vault). A service offered by most major Japanese banks. Customers pay an annual fee and can access the box during bank hours. Used for storing items like jewelry, ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{権利書|けんりしょ} (property deeds), {遺言書|いごんしょ} (wills), and other valuables.
